Jazmín Ortenzi (born 20 November 2001) is an Argentine tennis player.
She has a career-high singles ranking of No. 227 by the WTA , achieved on 3 March 2025. She also has a best doubles ranking of world No. 316, achieved on 10 February 2025. Ortenzi made her Fed Cup debut for Argentina in 2019 .
